image_description: A highly ornate, baroque-style religious altar situated within a church sanctuary. The structure features a central statue of a saint or deity on a pedestal, flanked by columns and intricate architectural details. The altar table at the bottom is covered with a decorative cloth featuring text. Red floral arrangements are placed on the altar shelf. The background includes arched niches and stained glass or painted panels.

artifact_observations.location: Bottom center, on the white altar cloth
artifact_observations.reasoning: The gold lettering on the white cloth is nonsensical and malformed. It resembles text but fails to form legible words, a common AI artifact where character structures melt into each other.
The intricate details in the upper archway and side niches appear slightly 'mushy' or over-smoothed, lacking the crisp edges expected from high-resolution photography of carved stone.
The connection between the central statue's feet and the pedestal is somewhat indistinct, with slight blending of geometry that makes the physical support unclear.

custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the text on the altar cloth. If the text auditor confirms it is gibberish, this is a significant structural/semantic defect. Also, verify if the 'ornate detailing' holds up under scrutiny or if it dissolves into noise upon magnification.
